notes: This is a typescript sheet with extensive handwritten and typed corrections. The underlined heading continues into the opening paragraph. No date or authorial page number is visible. The only lower-corner number is archive 17, recorded as a comment rather than mspage.

The first section describes conjugacy classes of tensor-compatible exact filtrations, a filtration scheme, a scheme ST_c of one-parameter subgroup homomorphisms, Lévi couples, and two displayed morphisms said to be canonically isomorphic. These are statements read from the sheet, not results independently proved here.

The second paragraph assumes characteristic zero, introduces Dyn_c for maps from Sl(2,k), replaces an underlined cancelled torseur by espace homogène, adds stabilizer information, cancels a purported torseur explanation, and starts the definition of Un_c. The sentence continues beyond the bottom of this sheet.

The explicit hesitation is “j'ignore dans quelle mesure c'est vraiment nécessaire”. The added research question is “il faudrait regarder la structure de ces Z_o; dimension, semi-simplicité”. Neither is converted into a mathematical assertion.
Literal forms retained include fixé une classe, three occurrences of rationelle, Auext, morphismesde, où un sous-groupe, and unaccented plural foncteurs fibres. The uncertain da/du remains uncertain.

The initial l/o overprint is preserved without asserting which impression came first. The small point before Cent is included with doubt because its status is uncertain. The original comma after non vide and the comma within the addition both remain visible.

No external text, web source, OCR, text recognition, other page, other reader, or root decision was consulted. There was no context loss during the task-status interruption. All 22 existing crop files were viewed once.
